subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: The world’s most visited countries: reading and scanning
outcomes: Talk about countries you would like to visit
Read about the world's most visited countries
Scan a text for details using key words

tf.s: The text is about the world's most visited countries.
Scanning is useful for finding names, dates and numbers.
Guessing before you read helps you think about the topic.
tf.why: Yes, predicting prepares your mind for the text.
A destination is the place you travel to.

tf.s: Key words are usually long sentences copied from the text.
tf.why: Key words are short words in the question that guide you.

tf.s: When you scan, you look for the key word in the text.
tf.why: Well done, the key word shows where the answer is.

tf.s: The Alhambra is an ancient city in China.
tf.why: The Alhambra is a palace in Spain.

tf.s: Italy is mentioned among the most visited countries.
Spain is one of the least visited countries in the text.
tf.why: Spain is one of the most visited countries.

tf.s: The report about the most visited countries is from 2014.

boxes.why: The World Tourism Organisation wrote it.

boxes.q: What do Scotland and the Lake District offer visitors?
boxes.why: They are famous for natural beauty.

o: A word that leads you to the answer
boxes.why: Key words point to the right part of the text.

boxes.q: Which modern building in China does the text mention?
boxes.why: It is a modern building in Shanghai.

boxes.q: Which skill helps you find a date quickly?
boxes.why: Scan for numbers to find dates.

boxes.q: What should you find in each question before you scan?
boxes.why: The key word guides your eyes.

o: Read the question and find the key word
Read every word of the text

mcq.q: Which phrase is closest in meaning to 'destination'?
